subject: Recovery evidence logistics and resilience attestation
messages:
From: Heather Liu <heather.liu@catalystmed.com>
To: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Mike Carter <mcarter@catalystmed.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Resilience evidence and RTO/RPO attestation for CatalystMed audit

Hi Irene / Marissa,

CatalystMed is starting a quick compliance window tied to our procurement milestones and need a focused set of BCP/DR artifacts from Redwood. The auditor has asked for the following items by COB Wednesday 2027-04-07:

- Formal RTO/RPO attestation by service tier (hosted API, dedicated, private)
- Recent recovery test summary (date, scope, outcome)
- Evidence index mapping SIG/CAIQ controls to Redwood artifacts
- Selected operational logs showing KV-cache warm/start timings for a failover scenario (sample window: 2026-11-15 to 2026-11-20)

Can you confirm what you can share and whether you can run a 1-hr remote walkthrough next week? Also let me know the preferred format for the attestation (signed PDF, DocuSign).

Thanks — we have a tight window on this and would appreciate a short checklist so our procurement team can close the purchase order.

Best,
Heather Liu
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
CatalystMed

[Attachment: catalyst_audit_request_20270401.pdf (pdf)]

From: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Heather Liu <heather.liu@catalystmed.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Resilience evidence and RTO/RPO attestation for CatalystMed audit

Hi Heather — thanks for the clear list. We can cover these items; outline below is what we'll deliver and expected timings.

Deliverables (target delivery by 2027-04-07):
- RTO/RPO attestation (signed PDF via DocuSign if you prefer) — will include per-deployment tier commitments and recent measured windows.
- Recovery test summary (summary PDF + underlying runbook excerpt) — Marissa will attach a short runbook extract and test log highlights.
- Evidence index mapping SIG/CAIQ controls to artifacts — we will provide an Excel index (Resilience Evidence Index).
- Operational log extracts (KV-cache warm times, failover traces) — Priyom will pull the requested sample window and sanitize any customer identifiers.

Action items for Redwood:
- Marissa: assemble the recovery summary + runbook excerpt and index.
- Priyom: extract and scrub logs, create a brief README for the log set.
- Karthik: review the attestation language and confirm SLA wording for Dedicated vs Hosted.

Preferred delivery: upload to a shared Drive folder and send DocuSign link for attestation. If CatalystMed needs earlier partial artifacts, we can stagger deliveries.

Irene
Head of Security & Compliance (on behalf of Redwood Inference)

[Attachment: none in this message]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, Heather Liu <heather.liu@catalystmed.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Resilience evidence and RTO/RPO attestation for CatalystMed audit

Thanks — working on this now. Short status/update and what I'll attach by Tuesday morning (2027-04-06):

1) Resilience Evidence Index (Excel) — contains pointers to SOC2 artifact IDs, CAIQ mapping, and test run IDs. (will upload: resilience_evidence_index.xlsx)
2) DR Runbook summary (PDF) — 2 pages with steps for cold warm start and canary failover; includes last full test date and rollout notes. (will upload: DR-runbook-summary.pdf)
3) Recovery test summary (inline) — 2026-11-18, simulated region failover; outcome: recovery within SLA for hosted tier, minor cache-warm latency spike on Dedicated (6s median additional). Logs available as zipped extracts.
4) Preliminary attestation draft — will send to Karthik for wording; propose we use DocuSign for final sign-off.

Priyom: can you confirm ETA for the sanitized KV-cache log bundle (rto_sensor_logs_2026-11.zip)? We need to verify no PII before upload.

Heather: do you want a separate spreadsheet mapping each SIG/CAIQ resilience control to our artifacts, or is the single index sufficient for your auditor? Happy to split if they prefer a control-by-control view.

-Marissa
Sr. Reliability Program Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: resilience_evidence_index.xlsx (will follow)]

From: Heather Liu <heather.liu@catalystmed.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, Mike Carter <mcarter@catalystmed.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Resilience evidence and RTO/RPO attestation for CatalystMed audit

Perfect — that plan works. Two quick clarifications:

1) Auditor preference: single index is fine, but they will call out specific controls for evidence. If possible, flag the highest-priority controls (SOC2: CC6.1/CC6.2; SIG: IV2, IV3) in the index so we can jump to artifacts during the walkthrough.
2) Walkthrough: can we schedule a 1-hour call on Monday 2027-04-05 10:00–11:00 PT? On the call will be our procurement lead and a technical auditor. Please include whoever will present the runbook and logs.

If you can upload the partial artifacts by end of day Tuesday, that gives the auditor a chance to pre-read. DocuSign for attestation is preferred.

Thanks again — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Heather
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
CatalystMed
